model.missing_evidence_rule: omit missing dimensions and renormalize available weights

missing_dimension_completion_bounds.method: For each property, retain observed dimension values and complete every currently missing dimension at 0 and at 100. Recalculate on the full 100-point weight base. These are structural extremes, not production imputations.

segment_evidence.reporting_rule: Only segments with at least 5 observations are reported as calibration evidence.

evidence_gate_decision.reason: The observed cohort shows that equal or higher numeric coverage does not guarantee band stability. Missing-dimension composition materially changes the unresolved score range, and Trajectory remains absent from all persisted latest-property observations.
evidence_gate_decision.candidate_research_rule: Evaluate future certification using both evidence composition and score/band stability under bounded missing-dimension completion, not coverage percentage alone.
why_not_enforced_now: Trajectory is absent from 212 of 212 latest persisted properties.
Overassessment Position is present on only 21 of 212 latest persisted properties.
The cohort is geographically concentrated, with 196 of 212 reportable observations in Camden County.
Only one property class has enough observations for a stable class-level segment report.
Extreme completion bounds are a sensitivity control and are not a calibrated empirical distribution for missing dimensions.

score_history_governance_reconciliation.client_user_id_filter_reason: Row visibility remains enforced by Supabase RLS. Client readers should use the governed history projection and not duplicate ownership semantics in query code.

decisions.next_calibration_priority: Build a representative non-writing cohort with observed Trajectory and materially broader independent Overassessment Position evidence, then rerun perturbation, leave-one-out, missingness, rank, band and segment tests.
